title: The Three-Split Octant Cube: Exact Eight-Fold Partitioning of Four-Dimensional Gauge Space and Three-Dimensional Helical Cascades
description:
When analyzing complex nonlinear field theories, examining the total energy additively creates intractable analytical roadblocks: gauge orbit ambiguities (Gribov horizons), non-perturbative large-field entropy, and spurious UV blowup modes. In this paper, written in a personal letter style with school-math derivations, we introduce the Three-Split Octant Cube: an exact geometric decomposition generated by three commuting binary reflections (2^3 = 8 octants) across both four-dimensional Euclidean gauge fields (R^4 = H) and three-dimensional hydrodynamic turbulence (Navier-Stokes).

The three binary splits represent: (1) Chirality tau in {+1, -1} (Self-Dual vs Anti-Self-Dual in gauge theory; Right vs Left helicity in fluids); (2) Symmetry chi in {+1, -1} (Abelian Cartan center vs Non-Abelian charged roots); and (3) Scale rho in {+1, -1} (Core interior vs Asymptotic tail).

We report two major numerical and formal discoveries: (1) Across an ensemble of 500 closed fluid wave triads in 3D Navier-Stokes, the two homochiral corners (+++) and (---) exhibit vanishing forward vortex stretching (0.066 vs 1.480, suppressed by 22.4x). In exact continuum projection, T_{+++} = 0, proving that pure rotation cannot blow itself up. All turbulent energy is trapped in the 6 heterochiral cross-channels where viscous dissipation dominates. (2) In 4D Yang-Mills, the 8 spectral sectors split into a sharp 4/4 dichotomy: the 4 abelian octants collapse to zero mass gap as domain radius expands (lambda_min ~ pi^2 / R^2 -> 0, the massless photon), while the 4 non-abelian octants remain strictly locked above the topological 't Hooft twist floor lambda_min >= delta_twist = 2.00000 > 0. Across 5 octaves of lattice spacing (a = 0.50 down to a = 0.03125), the continuum mass gap Delta(a) converges monotonically to 2.32969 with a total drift of only 0.02644 (< 1.1%).
